description: This file defines a Go package 'oomparser' that extracts and processes Out-Of-Memory (OOM) events from Linux kernel logs using kmsgparser. It includes structures and functions for parsing OOM messages, extracting container and process information, and streaming OOM events.

classes.name: OomParser
classes.description: A wrapper around kmsgparser.Parser to extract OOM events from kernel logs.

classes.name: OomInstance
classes.description: Represents details of an OOM kill event, including process and container info.

methods.name: StreamOoms
methods.description: Streams OOM events as OomInstance objects from kernel logs.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new OomParser instance.
